title: 2022 fuel crisis & load-shedding
description: Global LNG/diesel price spike after Russia-Ukraine war forced gas rationing; diesel peakers ran heavily and nationwide load-shedding persisted through late 2022.
grid_impact: Liquid Fuel mean generation peaked at 6,391 MW in 2022 (vs 2,301 MW in 2021). Frequent load-shedding reduced effective supply.
data_note: Liquid Fuel 2022 yearly mean 6,391 MW confirmed in yearly_source_mix.csv

title: Payra coal plant commissioned
description: 1,320 MW Payra ultra-supercritical coal plant (BCPCL) commissioned at Kalapara, Patuakhali — first major USC coal unit and precursor to later Rampal/Matarbari fleet expansion.
grid_impact: Early coal baseload addition before 2022 liquid-fuel surge; coal mean still modest in 2022 (874 MW) until Rampal synced.

title: Steep tariff hike (Aug 2022)
description: Government raised electricity prices sharply (largest since 2020) to partially pass through soaring fuel import costs.
grid_impact: Demand-side response limited; crisis driven mainly by supply/fuel constraints rather than price elasticity.

title: National grid collapse
description: National grid failure around 14:00 local caused a ~7-hour blackout affecting most of Bangladesh (~130M people) amid ongoing gas shortages; supply largely restored within seven hours.
grid_impact: Hourly total generation fell to minimum 2,830 MW on 4-5 Oct 2022 in PGCB data.
data_note: Oct 4-5 2022 min total 2,830 MW, max 10,347 MW in cleaned hourly data

title: Rampal (Maitree) coal plant grid sync
description: 1,320 MW Rampal/Maitree Super Thermal Power Plant synchronized to the Bangladesh grid, adding major coal-fired baseload capacity.
grid_impact: Coal mean rose from 874 MW (2022) to 2,329 MW (2023) and 3,286 MW (2024) as coal displaced expensive liquid fuel.
data_note: Coal yearly mean trajectory 521→874→2329→3286 MW matches commissioning timeline

title: BERC tariff hike (Nov 2022)
description: BERC announced a further per-unit retail electricity tariff increase, the second major adjustment in 2022 after the August hike.
grid_impact: Continued cost-recovery during peak fuel-crisis period; supply constraints remained the binding limit on served load.

title: IMF USD 4.7B program approved
description: IMF approved extended fund facility as forex reserves fell; conditions included fiscal reforms and scrutiny of energy subsidies/fuel bills.
grid_impact: Liquid-fuel generation curtailed sharply in 2023 (mean 1,697 MW vs 6,391 MW in 2022) as dollar shortages limited fuel imports.
data_note: Liquid Fuel 2023 mean 1,697 MW — 73% drop from 2022

title: Tariff adjustment (Jan 2023)
description: Average retail electricity price raised ~5% as part of cost-recovery efforts under IMF program.
grid_impact: Tariff pass-through; generation mix shift to coal and imports more impactful on supply than price change.

title: Adani Godda supply begins
description: Adani Power's 1,496 MW Godda plant (Jharkhand, India) began exporting electricity to Bangladesh via dedicated transmission.
grid_impact: PGCB 'India - Adani' column first shows systematic flows in Aug 2024 (1,515 MW); yearly mean 840 MW in 2024, 994 MW in 2025.
data_note: MISMATCH: news reports commissioning Apr 2023 but PGCB column first non-zero 2024-08-28 — likely reporting lag or initial sub-threshold flows

title: First wind generation recorded
description: Utility-scale wind output first appears in PGCB hourly data, marking start of grid-connected wind contribution.
grid_impact: Wind remains small (mean ~10 MW in 2024-25) vs solar; renewable share still dominated by solar and hydro.
data_note: Wind first non-zero 2023-05-13 13:00 in full cleaned history

title: Dollar shortage hits fuel imports
description: State petroleum firm BPC warned of falling fuel reserves and >$300M owed to overseas suppliers as dollar shortage constrained fuel import payments, threatening supply disruptions.
grid_impact: Reinforced 2023 curtailment of liquid-fuel generation (mean 1,697 MW) as import finance became binding.
data_note: Liquid Fuel 2023 mean 1,697 MW — aligns with import-payment constraints under IMF program

title: January 2024 general election
description: Awami League returned to power amid opposition boycott; energy subsidy and import-payment policies continued under same administration.
grid_impact: No abrupt generation shift in Jan 2024 data; coal and solar growth trends continued.
data_note: 2024 yearly means stable transition from 2023 (total 11,171 vs 10,577 MW)

title: Interim government (Yunus)
description: Sheikh Hasina resigned after mass protests; Nobel laureate Muhammad Yunus sworn in to lead interim government. Interim administration later initiated reviews and renegotiation of legacy power-purchase deals.
grid_impact: Power-sector reviews of Adani and fuel contracts followed; no immediate drop in recorded generation in Aug-Sep 2024.
data_note: Daily mean total stable ~11,000-12,000 MW through Aug 2024

title: Adani flows in PGCB data
description: First non-zero hourly reading in 'India - Adani' column at 1,515 MW, indicating systematic reporting of Godda imports.
grid_impact: Adani became ~840-1,020 MW yearly mean contributor (~7-9% of total generation).
data_note: First non-zero 2024-08-28 01:00 at 1,515 MW in cleaned CSV

title: Nepal import via India
description: First trilateral Nepal→India→Bangladesh power flow inaugurated (up to 40 MW) under Oct 2024 tripartite sales agreement; PGCB Nepal column shows flows from 14 Nov 2024.
grid_impact: Nepal column first non-zero 38 MW on 2024-11-14; sustained ~38 MW from mid-2025.
data_note: MEA inauguration 2024-11-15; Nepal first non-zero 2024-11-14 19:00 at 38 MW — aligns with ~40 MW deal

title: 2024 pre-monsoon heatwave
description: Severe heatwave drove record cooling demand and renewed load-shedding concerns, though less acute than 2022 crisis.
grid_impact: April remains peak demand month (12,245 MW mean); solar share dips in May-Jun as irrigation load dominates.
data_note: monthly_summary.csv: Apr peak 12,245 MW mean; Jun solar dips to 83 MW mean

title: Adani deal renegotiation
description: Interim-government committee sought to renegotiate Adani Godda PPA terms including tax rebate, surcharge, and coal-price pass-through after payment disputes.
grid_impact: Adani supply had been reduced over unpaid dues; renegotiation aimed to stabilize ~1,600 MW import channel.

title: Adani supply restored
description: Adani Power restored full electricity exports to Bangladesh after roughly four months of reduced supply over unpaid bills.
grid_impact: Godda imports returned to contracted levels; Adani remained ~1 GW-class contributor in 2025 PGCB data.

title: February 2026 general election
description: Bangladesh held its first post-uprising parliamentary election; BNP-led coalition won, with Tarique Rahman sworn in as prime minister days later.
grid_impact: New administration signalled power-sector contract reviews and subsidy reform; generation data through Jun 2026 shows continued coal/import baseload.

title: Solar capacity build-out
description: Government approved utility-scale solar parks; grid solar grew steadily though share remains under 2% of total generation.
grid_impact: Solar mean 26→162 MW; yearly max 929 MW in 2025; solar share 0.27%→1.44%.

title: Coal displacement of liquid fuel
description: Payra, Rampal, and growing coal fleet shifted baseload from expensive oil/gas peakers to coal.
grid_impact: Coal share rose from 5% to 32% of mean generation; Liquid Fuel fell from 24% to 7% of mix (2021 vs 2026).
data_note: yearly_source_mix.csv: Coal 521→3621 MW, Liquid Fuel 2301→797 MW
